newsitem.title: USA: DHB wins 7-year $413 mln defense contract.
newsitem.headline: DHB wins 7-year $413 mln defense contract.

text.p: DHB Capital Group Inc said Monday its wholly-owned subsidiary DHB Armor Group Inc won a seven-year defense contract with a potential value of $413.4 million.

The contract, awarded by the U.S. Army Soldiers Systems Command, calls for DHB to design and develop the soft body armor components (vests) for the new U.S. Military modular body armor system/modular load system.
A DHB spokeswoman said the contract is worth $413.4 million if the army exercises its options to buy more than 100,000 vests for initial equipment fielding over a seven year period.
DHB's stock closed at 4-15/16 Friday on the Boston Stock Echnange, with the bid at 4-3/4 and offer at 5-1/2.
